title: Edit repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts: incoming execution traces carry the Thompson selection's correla
description: Edit repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts: incoming execution traces carry the Thompson selection's correlation id only as a tag of the form 'correlation:<id>' in body.tags, never in body.correlation_id, so the selection-outcome join (which keys on correlation_id) is always empty and no Thompson selection can be joined to its outcome. Fix it: before the trace is written (upstream of both the CREATE and the UPSERT write paths), when body.correlation_id is absent, derive it from body.tags by finding the entry that starts with 'correlation:' and stripping that prefix, assigning the result to body.correlation_id.
